title: Front matter of a page of korczis.github.io
description: Every content/*.md carries this front matter (TOML). It drives the page's title, SEO, Open Graph and Twitter tags, OG image, JSON-LD and its place in the site; nothing about a page is typed in a template. Validated by scripts/check-front-matter.mjs.

title.description: The page's name; `<title>` is `title · Tomas Korcak` unless extra.seo_title is set.

description.description: Meta description, og:description and the lead under the page header.

og_title.description: Headline of the generated OG image and og:title.

og_image.description: Generated by scripts/build-og.mjs from this front matter.

schema.description: Which JSON-LD page type templates/partials/seo.html emits.

category.description: Category pages only: a key of [categories] in data/projects.toml.
